name: Ruentex Interior Design Inc.
summary: Operating out of Taiwan, Ruentex Interior Design Inc. specializes in a broad range of services, including interior design and decoration, landscape architectural engineering, and construction. The company's extensive project portfolio encompasses diverse settings, from corporate offices and various residential and commercial properties to specialized landscape developments, laboratory installations, and educational or cultural institutions. Beyond its primary design and build capabilities, Ruentex also supplies an array of interior, landscape, and construction materials, complemented by comprehensive project management services. Established in 1991, the firm is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.
